questions.q: How does UNION differ from JOIN?
options: UNION and JOIN are functionally identical
JOIN removes duplicates; UNION never does
UNION only works within a single table; JOIN requires two tables
UNION stacks query results top to bottom (more rows); JOIN combines tables side by side (more columns)
questions.explain: This is the fundamental distinction — UNION appends result sets; JOIN widens rows with matched columns.

questions.q: What must be true of the queries combined with UNION?
options: They must both include a WHERE clause
They must query the exact same table
They must both use GROUP BY
They must return the same number of columns, with compatible types in the same position
questions.explain: Column count and type compatibility are the hard requirements — column names come from the first query.

questions.q: What is the one functional difference between UNION and UNION ALL?
options: UNION can combine more than two queries; UNION ALL cannot
UNION ALL only works with numeric columns
UNION ALL requires more columns than UNION
UNION removes duplicate rows across the combined result; UNION ALL keeps every row
questions.explain: That's the entire distinction — UNION behaves like an implicit DISTINCT applied across both result sets.

questions.q: Why is UNION ALL generally faster than UNION?
options: UNION has to compare every row against every other row to find and remove duplicates; UNION ALL skips that step
UNION ALL returns fewer rows, which is inherently faster
UNION ALL uses a different indexing strategy that UNION cannot access
There is no performance difference between the two
questions.explain: Deduplication is real computational work — skipping it when you don't need it is a meaningful performance win.

questions.q: What is the recommended default between UNION and UNION ALL, according to this lesson?
options: Always use UNION ALL, since UNION is deprecated
They should never be used interchangeably in any circumstance
Default to UNION always, for safety
Default to UNION ALL unless you specifically need duplicates removed
questions.explain: Don't pay for deduplication you don't actually need — UNION ALL is at least as fast, often significantly faster.
